description: Use this when the user wants a random number generator or number wheel: pick one or more random whole numbers between a min and a max (inclusive), with or without repeats, e.g. a random student number or who goes next. Uses cryptographic, unbiased randomness. Do not use for lottery or Powerball numbers, betting, or login credentials and security codes. For fun, classroom, and team decisions only; not for lotteries, gambling, or prize draws that have legal requirements.

count.description: How many numbers to pick, a whole number from 1 to 500, default 1, e.g. 5.

max.description: Largest possible whole number, inclusive, -1000000000 to 1000000000, default 100, e.g. 30 for a class of 30.

min.description: Smallest possible whole number, inclusive, -1000000000 to 1000000000, default 1, e.g. 1.

unique.description: If true (default) no number repeats, e.g. false to allow repeats like dice rolls.

name: pick_random_number
title: Pick random numbers
